items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I worked with Jack Carey at Seussberry... I worked out there with him, me, Jack Carey, Lil' Lawrence, and Emil Raleigh.

ctx.x: You know what I want to ask you something you might know, plenty of people whom we've talked to, they don't ever say too much about Jack Carey, a trombone player.
Old man Jack? Yeah. I worked with Jack Carey at-
That's a man who had three and four bands or-
